description: 5 should-trigger + 5 should-not-trigger queries. Should-trigger covers DE + EN posture/scorecard/baseline phrasings. Should-not-trigger covers the neighbouring security skills (vuln hunt, authz chain, threat model, secure coding, agent config) whose vocabulary overlaps.

queries.q: how mature is the security posture of our billing module?
give me a security scorecard for this codebase with evidence per category
wie sicher ist dieses Modul aufgestellt? Bitte pro Kategorie bewerten
baseline our security maturity before the hardening sprint
rate input validation, secrets and tenant isolation for the API package
audit this module for SQL injection and XSS vulnerabilities
review the authorization chain for the invoice download route
threat-model the new file-upload feature before we build it
write a policy and gate for this new admin action
red-team my Claude agent's MCP and hook config
